authorization: User explicitly accepted table-v1-design.md and requested implementation, with future hand-drawn line compatibility. This is a scoped feature extension, not an official Gate or replacement of unrelated frozen authority.

decisions.wire: Append Table/1 ObjectKind 11, ObjectContent branch 13 and EditTable Operation/tag 20. Existing tags and legacy bytes retain meaning. Table requires snapshot3, table-v1 requirement and explicit reader bit64; all-current reader profile127. Table is a leaf.
decisions.identity: Rows/columns use Runtime-allocated Id128 values scoped to their table. Cell identity is table,row,column. Only Runtime creates axis identities; explicit Undo restores preimages. No SDK construction of canonical objects.
decisions.limits: 1..64 rows and columns, at most1024 cells; dimensions24..16384 world units; at most1MiB UTF-8 text per table. Default3x3, row48, column120. Cell padding6; fixed height with wrapped clipped text. Finite colors in[0,1], font size1..512, grid width0..16.
decisions.editing: EditTable holds action kind and complete validated before/after TableContent. Runtime constructs domain changes. Compare-before guard rejects conflicts atomically, including compensation, rather than overwriting unrelated remote edits; v1 deliberately conservative conflict policy, no CRDT. Text cell edits use existing RichTextDelta preparation and TextEditSession/IME with explicit row/column token identity. All fields are owned values.
decisions.grid: Canonical grid style version1 stores color and width. It does not bake lines into shapes or text. Shared renderer receives row/column boundary geometry. A future versioned stroke style/seed must be capability-gated; unknown styles fail closed. No reserved bytes interpreted as hand-drawn today.
decisions.sdk: runtime.table facade delegates to shared Runtime owner: create/read/select/edit/insert/remove/resize/style/grid. Numeric indices only for creation/insertion position; mutations of existing cells/axes use stable IDs and generation. Windows uses shared Session vocabulary, no new DLL export/internal type exposure.
decisions.version: Feature implementation is local development; do not republish0.0.1 or create a Release without another publication request. Next feature release follows0.1.0 policy.
